Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the rgiht lane on a Sugar Land, Texas roadway when Driver 2, operating a vehicle in the
adjacent lane, began to change lanes without a sufficient view of the vehicle beside them. The two vehicles made
contact along their passenger-side and driver-side panels, and Driver 2's vehicle pushed Driver 1's vehicle toward the
shoulder before both came to rest. Driver 1 and a Passenger were present in the vehicle at the time, and responding
officers and independent witnesses at the scene confirmed their presence. Driver 1 reported neck and back strain
shortly after the collision and was evaluated at the scene. The damage visible on Driver 1's vehicle is consistent with
the side-impact described by the parties, and the injuries reported are consistent with the force of a lateral collision of
this kind. Driver 2 acknowledged the lane change and did not dispute the sequence of events. Witness statements
and photographs taken at the scene support the account given by both drivers. No prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle
was known to the responding officers or reported by any party. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy
covering the vehicle involved. Based on the information gathered, the reporting officer has documented this incident
as a sideswipe collision during a lane change.
